summary: State Senator Don A. Moore wrote a brief letter to the Northeastern Illinois Planning Commission recommending approval of the $9,229,000 federal grant for the Lincoln Highway improvement project (NIPC #74-228). His letter expresses unqualified support for the project without conditions or reservations.
complaint_summary: Senator Moore recommends approval of the $9,229,000 federal grant to assist with the Lincoln Highway improvement project.

statement.text:
Please accept this correspondence in regard to the above captioned project. It is my recommendation that the Federal Grant requested of $9,229,000 be approved to assist with this project.
If I can be of any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Very truly yours,
SENATOR DON A. MOORE
